meta.title: Token Usage
meta.description: Collects the usage reported by the model, totals tokens per day and per model, and adds a viewer entry at the bottom left of the web UI (above the settings button): a stacked bar chart shows each model's usage and share per day, and hovering a segment reveals the model, its color, the share and the amount. The ledger lives under the app data root (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\data\usage.json), not in the plugin directory.
